 Which House races are still counting votes?
 Tuesday, 3 November 2026, 11:05 
 Several key House races are too close for CNN to project a winner, and vote counting will continue well beyond Election Day. 
 Counting procedures vary by state, so some races could be decided quickly while others may take days.
 This is reported by CNN .
 The list below shows the House races where CNN has yet to project a winner, along with estimates of the ballots remaining to be counted in each.
 Follow along as results start coming in on Election Night. The graphics will update as CNN projects winners in these races.
